subject: Handoff: Skyward Health — implementation start plan and kickoff owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Handoff: Skyward Health — implementation start plan (SOW + MAP attached)

Dylan — quick handoff note for Skyward Health (closed this morning). High-level: $420k ARR, Dedicated capacity (reserved), 12-month term, target go-live window is Sept 1. Key background and immediate asks below.

Snapshot:
- Decision maker: Lena Russo, VP Product (primary contact).
- Technical lead (buyer): procurement@skywardhealth.com (procurement + security loop).
- Primary need: low-latency inference for triage/clinical suggestion workflow; 99th pctl latency SLO required.
- Deployment mode: Dedicated capacity with optional VPC peering later. Customer asked for private peering and SOC2 evidence.

Immediate milestones we promised:
1) Signed SOW and PO in next 7–10 days (SOW attached, DocuSign link below).
2) Kickoff + tech intake week of Aug 9–13 (customer preferred).
3) Ingestion spec and sample data exchange before kickoff (we promised a pre-kick checklist).

Risks / negotiables:
- Security questionnaire still open (they will send the standard enterprise checklist).
- Token-budget: customer expects <10ms median and aggressive tail; recommend we plan for a small canary on our Dedicated pool first.

Attachments: SOW_Skyward_v3.pdf (SOW), ingestion_spec.xlsx (data spec). Also shared MAP (mutual_action_plan.docx) that we should present at kickoff.

Recommended owners:
- CSM / Kickoff owner: Tessa Morgan (assign to Tessa for runbook and training cadence).
- Technical intake & deployment lead (runtime/provisioning): Karthik Iyer (for Dedicated capacity sizing, autoscale, and peering).
- Sales Sponsor (open escalation): Marissa Cole.

Next steps for you:
- Can you confirm Tessa's availability for an intro call and pencil in Aug 10 or Aug 11 at 10am PT?
- Karthik — can you review the ingestion_spec.xlsx and flag any blockers for Dedicated provisioning (GPU class, PV, VPC peering timeline)?

Thanks — I’ll move DocuSign once procurement gives final PO number.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lena Russo <lena.russo@skywardhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Skyward Health — implementation start plan (SOW + MAP attached)

Thanks Marissa — and hi Lena, great to meet you over email. Welcome aboard. Brief reply to outline who will own what and proposed kickoff windows.

Agreed owners:
- CSM / Kickoff: Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwood.com) — will run the first 30/60/90 plan and training sessions.
- Tech lead (Dedicated provisioning & runtime): Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwood.com) — will scope GPU class, autoscale, and VPC peering requirements.
- Delivery sponsor: Dylan Brooks (me) — will own executive escalations and SLA alignment.

Lena — proposed kickoff slots: Tue Aug 10 at 10am PT or Wed Aug 11 at 9am PT. Can you confirm which works? For the kickoff we plan: 30 mins intro + 60 mins technical intake (ingestion, auth, test data). Please bring your security/compliance contact if possible so we can triage the SOC2 checklist early.

Karthik — quick ask: review ingestion_spec.xlsx and call out any items that need a pre-provisioning task (e.g., specific disk throughput, NVMe, or peering windows). If Dedicated pool requires GPU reservation lead time, note that in an updated timeline.

I’ll circulate the MAP doc during the kickoff and link the DocuSign once PO is submitted.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx (for reference). DocuSign link (SOW) will be posted as soon as procurement confirms PO.

—
Dylan Brooks
Director, Sales Operations (Redwood Inference)
dylan.brooks@redwood.com
From: Lena Russo <lena.russo@skywardhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Skyward Health Procurement <procurement@skywardhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 00:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Skyward Health — implementation start plan (SOW + MAP attached)

Thanks all — glad to meet you. Aug 11 at 9am PT works best for our team.

A couple quick items from procurement/security before kickoff:
- I attached our PO stub (PO_78912.pdf) — procurement will issue the final PO after DocuSign.
- We will send the security questionnaire by end of day Monday. Can Karthik confirm a point of contact for SOC2 artifacts and network peering details?
- Pre-kick checklist request: sample data format, auth options (API key vs mTLS), and expected tokenization/length limits. If you have a short intake form we can fill, please attach.

Also: internal expectation note — we'll want a 2-week canary on dedicated capacity with traffic mirroring from prod to validate latency and model outputs. Is that part of your standard go-live playbook?

Looking forward to Aug 11.

Best,
Lena Russo
VP Product, Skyward Health
lena.russo@skywardhealth.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 01:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Handoff: Skyward Health — implementation start plan (internal next steps)

Internal quick triage after Lena's reply:
- Karthik, please reply to Lena with the SOC2 artifacts POC and a short answers doc for the pre-kick checklist by EOD today. Suggest PPE: include a short doc that covers: auth options (API key, OAuth2, mTLS), typical tokenization limits, and earliest window for VPC peering (we need to confirm lead time for routing & firewall updates).
- Tessa, draft a 30/60/90 kickoff agenda and include a canary plan for the 2-week mirroring period (governance: rollback metrics, acceptance gates, who signs off).
- Marissa, please ping procurement if PO timeline changes; once DocuSign is out, we should request the PO number and attach to the SOW.

I'll book Aug 11 09:00 PT for the kickoff on our side and send the calendar invite once Lena confirms the external invite.

—
Dylan
